died.name: John Bowen
died.cause: While attending a 9 December NFL game at Shea Stadium, the 20-year-old native of Nashua, New Hampshire was struck in the head by a radio-controlled aircraft shaped like a lawn mower being flown by a local model plane club during halftime.
